create_planets_simulation: create a Planets simulation with N bodies that attract each other gravitationally in 2D
create_electrons_simulation: create an Electrons simulation with N bodies that repel each other in 2D space
create_idealgas_simulation: create an IdealGas simulation with N non-interacting bodies moving freely in 2D
animate_simulation_to_mp4: animate an IdealGas simulation and save the output as an MP4 video file
step_simulation: step a Planets simulation forward in time using ODE integration with gravity
